Course Overview

The Product Management course is designed to equip aspiring product leaders with the practical skills to build, launch, and scale digital products that solve real-world problems.
You’ll learn the complete product lifecycle — from ideation and market research to design collaboration, agile execution, and growth strategy.

This beginner-friendly course blends strategic thinking with hands-on tools, helping you transition into a career as a Product Manager, Product Owner, or Startup Founder.

Learning Outcome

  1. Understand the core principles of product management and the end-to-end product lifecycle.
  2. Conduct user and market research to identify customer needs and define product opportunities.
  3. Collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams (engineering, design, marketing) using agile methodologies.
  4. Develop and present product strategies, roadmaps, and metrics for business growth.

Career Opportunities

  1. United States – $105,000 – $155,000 USD
  2. United Kingdom – £65,000 – £95,000 GBP
  3. Canada – $85,000 – $120,000 CAD
  4. Germany – €70,000 – €100,000 EUR
  5. Nigeria – ₦7 million – ₦12 million NGN
  6. Kenya – KSh 3.5 million – KSh 6 million KES
  7. Remote/Global Roles – $80,000 – $130,000 USD

Career Pathways

  1. Product Manager
  2. Product Owner
  3. Technical Product Manager
  4. Growth Product Manager
  5. Startup Founder / Entrepreneur

What You Will Learn

Go from Idea to Impact, become a Product Manager in 3-6 Months.

Module 1 - Introduction to Product Management
  • Product Management: Introduction and Relevance
  • Scope and purpose of product management
  • Key roles and responsibilities of a product manager
  • How PMs bridge business, technology, and users
  • Product Development Lifecycle
  • Organizing and Managing a Product Team
  • Product Management Tools
  • Software Development Methodologies
Module 2 - Understanding Users & Market Research
  • Customer discovery and problem validation (Discovery and Validation)
  • User research frameworks (JTBD, personas, empathy maps)
  • Market segmentation and competitive analysis
  • Persona Building
Module 3 - Product Vision, Strategy & Roadmapping
  • Product Vision and Mission
  • Writing a Product Vision Statement
  • Setting strategic goals (North Star Metric, OKRs)
  • Roadmapping Tools (Trello, Productboard etc)
  • Mission, OKRs, and KPIs
  • Create a high-level roadmap
Module 4 - Ideation, Hypothesis Creation & Validation
  • Prioritization Frameworks (RICE, MoSCoW)
  • Minimum Viable Product
  • Validation of Metrics
  • Formulating testable hypotheses
Module 5 - Defining Requirements: PRD & User Stories
  • PRD: Writing Product Requirement Documents (PRDs), Anatomy of a PRD, Writing User Stories (INVEST Framework)
  • Breaking features into user stories and acceptance criteria
Module 6 - Agile Development & Working with Engineering
  • Agile Principles: Understand Agile, Scrum, and Kanban frameworks
  • Sprint planning and backlog grooming
  • PMs role in standups and retrospectives
  • Collaborating effectively with engineering teams
  •  
Module 7 - User Centered Design
  • What User Centered Design really means
  • User Research Fundamentals
  • Defining Problems, Not Just Solutions
  • Designing for Users
  • Testing and Iterating
  • Applying UCD in the PM Workflow
  • Collaborating with UX/UI designers
  • Accessibility and Inclusion in design
Module 8 - Data, Metrics & Product Analytics
  • Key metrics that define product success (AARRR framework)
  • Product Analytic Tools
Module 9 - Go-to-Market Strategy & Launch Planning
  • Product Launch – Positioning and messaging
  • Marketing, sales, and customer success alignment
  • Launch checklist
  • Growth loops and early traction strategies
Module 10 - Stakeholder Management & Communication
  • Stakeholder Mapping
  • Cross-functional relationships
  • Communication frameworks (RACI, DACI)
  • Build influence through storytelling and data
  • Writing product updates
Module 11 - Career Preparation
  • Demonstrating end-to-end PM skills
  • Product Management Terms
  • Creating a stellar Product Management CV
  • Prepare for PM interviews and portfolio reviews (behavioural + case style)
  • Building your PM portfolio
